entities.summary: Edwin Thomas "Ted" Astley was a British composer. His best known works are British television themes and scores, most notably the main themes for  Department S, The Saint, Danger Man and The Baron. He also successfully diversified into symphonic pop and the arrangement of his theme to The Saint, as re-recorded by Orbital, reached number three in the UK singles chart.
